newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai firm Karat in Vietnam venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai firm Karat in Vietnam venture.

text.p: Thailand's Karat Sanitaryware said on Thursday it had reached a joint venture agreement with Vietnamese partners to set up a sanitaryware factory in Vietnam.
The new venture, Karat Hai Hung (Vietnam) Co Ltd, will have registered capital of $5 million, of which 70 percent would be owned by Karat, the firm said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Vietnam's Hai Hung Construction Co Ltd and Hai Hung Investment and Development Co Ltd will hold 20 percent and 10 percent stakes respectively, it said.
The factory will produce 100,000 units of various sanitaryware in the first year and 500,000 units a year when it reaches full capacity after the third year of operation, it said.
